In August, consumer prices increased 0.4% from July and 3.4% over the year, in line with the 3.4% annual rise in July and consistent with expectations. Core CPI, which excludes more volatile energy and food prices, rose 0.3% from July and 2.4% over the year, down slightly from the 2.5% 12-month increase the month prior.
